_about: The machine form of docs/guides/POSITIONING.md, the one positioning source of this repository (SITE-REPRESENTATION rules 1 to 4, tickets 155 and 249). Read by tools/Test-SitePositioning.ps1 and tools/Build-SitePages.ps1; nothing at run time reads it. 'positioning' holds the family sentence and the three components in order, each with the state the owner decided (shipped | in-development); 'profiles' the two install intents and where each is explained; 'availability' the component x channel matrix, every cell with the files that prove it (the gate reads them, so a packaging change that contradicts a cell fails the check until this file and the pages say the new truth); 'development' the words that mark a component still in development and the places where it may be named; 'surfaces' names, per file, the region that lists the components ('scopes': regular expressions, the region is the named group 'region' when there is one, else the whole match) and per component a regular expression that finds its words in that file's language - the gate fails when a region is not found, when a component the surface must name (the first 'names' components) is absent, or when one component's words come after the next one's. 'editions' declares what a visitor can obtain, with the one display name each (owned by docs/guides/PRODUCT_NAMING.md). 'facts' types the language count and the platform floor once; the gate reads their real sources and compares every typed claim in the scanned files with them. A change of the order, of a state or of a value is a change of POSITIONING.md and of this file first, then of every surface.

positioning.lead: Three optional parts: a media viewer and sorter, a local SFTP folder-sharing service, and a Media Exchange Server (in development, not released yet) - start with the viewer or with the folder-sharing server, and add the rest only if you want it.

components.title: Media viewer and sorter
components.says: The viewer and sorter: fast paging through huge folders, one key per file, slideshow, playback.

components.title: Local SFTP folder sharing
components.says: The Share Manager and its SFTP worker: the folders you pick open on an Android phone, another copy of the program or any SFTP client. Optional, off until switched on.

capabilities.title: FileDO virtual disks
capabilities.says: Hosting FileDO .fdd virtual disks through the same worker. A capability of sharing, off until a disk is registered.

components.title: Media Exchange Server
components.says: A separate server you run yourself: devices enroll into an account on it and reach each other through it. Not folder sharing; neither the viewer nor local sharing needs it.

focusedEditions.reason: The Server edition is a focused package: the folder-sharing service leads and the viewer rides along as an unticked component (specification 132 section 3.3). Its page repeats the family sentence, which is judged; its own lead and its winget manifest are not a list of what the product does. It installs the folder-sharing service only - never the Media Exchange Server.

availability._about: The component x channel matrix of docs/guides/POSITIONING.md section 4.1, rendered into server.html (region gen:matrix) by tools/Build-SitePages.ps1 and held to the packaging by tools/Test-SitePositioning.ps1. It describes the packages as DEFINED in this source tree (the installer scripts, the winget manifests, the MSIX manifest and packager, the release workflow); what the Releases page offers today is the latest published release, and What's new says which version brought each part. A cell is [state, evidenceId..]; every evidence pattern must match its file, so a packaging change that contradicts a cell fails the check. 'winget' is not a channel of its own: it downloads the same setup.exe as the Releases page, and its silent install takes the first installer type, 'full' - the same default as the wizard. The Microsoft Store has no unattended hosting: a Store package cannot register a Windows service.

development._about: A component whose state is 'in-development' may be named (the owner's decision of 2026-10-20 replaced the Q155-2 reservation) but never sold: each mention of it on a scanned file is within 'window' characters of a marker in some language, is not inside a link to a download, installer, release asset, store or winget command, and carries no date. The windows are judged, not a quoted sentence, so a surface may word its own sentence.

discoverability._about: The machine form of docs/guides/POSITIONING.md section 7 (the worksheet's derived field table, ticket 207 T-1; canon PROMOTION section 2). Every discoverability field of a channel is derived from this block, so a channel never drifts from another: GitHub description and topics, winget Tags, Store search terms, the page titles and the social card. 'applied' names the channels whose fields tools/Test-SitePositioning.ps1 holds against the tree today; a channel joins it in the step that writes its fields (winget and the Store at T-8). Competitor names are never written here: the gate reads them from the internal research guide named in 'competitorTermsSource' (owner decision 2026-10-09, D-7).
